test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of :: ?

# : VXB :: GIM : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

Given:

# : VXB :: GIM : %

**Option 1) # = SUY , % = LLP**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84e0a7a0aab5d95371323651897360cba2154b8ba8a311bf93ba439690c62c5e.png] 

 

**For GIM to % (LLP)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/105726adaadb2f1b97158407ad330de63ec5d91fc9a778c7c7d92ff36d05240c.png] 

 

Option 1 is incorrect.

**Option 2) # = SEY , % = JLP**

**For # (SEY) to VXB**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47af1062c1c822e1c73968e1058fcda8a5fe7c65cce6d583cd6ea801cc55ab6b.png] 

**For GIM to % (JLP)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30809675943fa9f70656e526e6c69d4913efc157da19dd316ab7e97b5852d1ab.png] 

 

Option 2 is incorrect.

**Option 3) # = SUY , % = JLP**

**For # (SUY) to VXB**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd542880bb089eb1bd8313c5f5c6271dc93fb217031100eff0f7b9d8eb9c70db.png] 

**For GIM to % (JLP)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/183a467a5cca05f9b789763641da1527df42c801c3dca0637b6d3b2c6edcbc0b.png] 

 

**Option 3 is correct.**

**Option 4) # = SUY , % = JLL**

**For # (SUY) to VXB**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2e6494b4ac587e09af909866a53060ec0326717ce58135f90e241364486c48b.png] 

**For GIM to % (JLL)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44de000488ea51e7cd565e7065265be1a08164fe90838f7aab57a4acd894a0c0.png] 

 

Option 4 is incorrect.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
